turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My rescue dog gets anxious with change. How do I move house without stressing him out?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep his routine as normal as possible during packing. Same walks, same feeding times.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, I'm trying to get more vegetables into my week and I've got three plans in mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan A is a big soup on Sunday that I eat for lunch every day, mostly lentils, carrots and greens.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan B is sneaking veg into everything, like grated courgette in sauces and spinach in my eggs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Plan C is a veg box delivery, which forces me to cook whatever turns up each week, even weird stuff.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the last option, I'm finished. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd combine them a little. Sneak veg into what you already cook, like in plan B, and make the soup only every other week. The box is great fun, but if you're busy, half of it might end up wilting in the fridge.
